summary_bullets: Rename Gate A Shape 2 show-plan option to See full plan and document its drop-on-reprompt behavior.
Add Gate C See full plan as a structured primary option with cap-aware drop-on-reprompt semantics while preserving Other as an unchanged-option escape path.
Update the Gate C large-plan note and regression pins to enforce the new prompt wording and contracts.
commit_message:
Add structured See full plan approval option

Update /design Gate A and Gate C approval contracts so Gate A uses the See full plan label and Gate C exposes See full plan as a structured primary option. Preserve the Gate C Other escape path without mutating its option set, update the large-plan summary note, and pin the new wording in the design structure and preview tests.
